description: Data Layer & Performance Optimization: Wrap all Supabase calls with React Query (already done in main.jsx but verify all screens use it), add debounce to search/filter inputs, implement pagination UI components for reports/advisories/operations lists (hooks already exist, add UI controls), memoize expensive components and computations, ensure lazy loading for route-level code splitting (already done for Map/Admin/Legal but verify), add loading='lazy' to all images, create skeleton components for data tables and cards, cache expensive calculations like weather aggregations and damage totals
steps: 1. Audit all screens for direct supabase.from() calls. Confirm HomeScreen, MapScreen, AdminDashboard, EmergencyScreen, ElNinoMonitoringDashboard already use React Query or can be refactored. Document any remaining direct calls to migrate
2. Extract useDebounce hook from components/map/SearchBar.jsx into src/hooks/useDebounce.js for reuse
3. In AdminMapScreen.jsx line 552, wrap searchQuery state with useDebounce(searchQuery, 300) before filtering reports. Import from hooks/useDebounce.js
4. In HomeScreen.jsx line 787 (barangay search), wrap searchQuery with useDebounce(searchQuery, 300). Apply debounced value to filteredBarangays useMemo
5. In AdminDashboard.jsx, find all input onChange handlers for search/filter fields and apply useDebounce with 300ms delay before triggering filter operations

6. Create src/components/ui/PaginationControls.jsx: reusable component accepting { currentPage, totalPages, onPageChange, isLoading }. Render Prev/Next buttons and page number. Style matching existing button patterns

7. In AdminDashboard.jsx ReportsTab, the usePaginatedReports hook is already imported. Add PaginationControls component below the reports list, wire up fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage from useInfiniteQuery result

8. Similarly add pagination controls to AdvisoriesTab, BFP Operations, CDRRMO Operations, Hospital Records sections in AdminDashboard using existing hooks (usePaginatedAdvisories, usePaginatedBFPOps, usePaginatedCDRRMOOps, usePaginatedHospitalRecords)

9. In HomeScreen.jsx, identify large ReportCard list renders. Confirm ReportCard is already memoized (src/components/ui/ReportCard.jsx line 58). Verify parent list doesn't recreate callbacks - wrap any inline functions passed as props with useCallback

10. In MapScreen.jsx, confirm useMemo for stationCoverageGeoJSON and heatIndexCoverageGeoJSON (lines 388, 397). Verify onMapLoad, refreshWeatherData, fitAllPins are useCallback wrapped (lines 423, 515). No changes needed if already optimized
11. Create src/components/ui/LoadingSkeleton.jsx: reusable skeleton component for cards, rows, and avatars. Accept variant prop: 'card' | 'row' | 'avatar'. Use CSS animations for shimmer effect
12. In HomeScreen.jsx, when loading advisories or reports, show <LoadingSkeleton variant='card' count={3} /> instead of plain 'Loading...' text
13. In AdminDashboard.jsx OverviewTab, when fetching analytics data, show LoadingSkeleton for metric cards and chart areas until data loads
14. In MapScreen.jsx, the existing map loading fallback shows MapIcon + text. Enhance with LoadingSkeleton for map pins list if applicable

15. Audit all tags in components. Confirm loading='lazy' on: ReportCard (line 85), PhotoCard (line 53), AdminDashboard (lines 1605, 3023, 3091). Add loading='lazy' to any remaining tags in HomeScreen, EmergencyScreen, ProfileScreen

16. In HomeScreen.jsx, the heatIndex calculation (line 358 useMemo) is already cached. Verify weatherInfo, filteredBarangays, waveInfo, formattedRecordedAt, liveStationData are all useMemo wrapped. Confirm heroBgUrl useMemo (line 311). No changes if already optimized
17. In ElNinoMonitoringDashboard.jsx, if there are large data aggregations or chart data preparations, wrap with useMemo based on the data dependencies
18. Run 'npm run build' and check dist/ chunk sizes. Confirm code splitting produced separate chunks for MapScreen, AdminDashboard, LegalScreen, AdminMapScreen
19. Test in browser: verify debounced search doesn't trigger on every keystroke, pagination controls appear and work, skeletons show while loading, images lazy load as you scroll
acceptance_criteria: Search inputs do not trigger filter operations on every keystroke, only after 300ms pause
Pagination controls (Prev/Next, page number) appear below paginated lists in AdminDashboard
Clicking Next Page loads next set of 50 records without full page reload
While data loads, skeleton placeholders appear instead of blank space or 'Loading...' text
All images have loading='lazy' attribute and load only when scrolled into view (check Network tab throttling)
npm run build output shows separate chunk files for MapScreen, AdminDashboard, LegalScreen
No console warnings about missing dependencies in useEffect/useMemo/useCallback arrays
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0, verify dist/assets/ contains separate chunks for lazy-loaded routes
Open DevTools Network tab, set throttling to Slow 3G
Navigate to Maps tab and confirm MapScreen chunk loads separately
In AdminDashboard ReportsTab, type in search field and observe only one filter operation after you stop typing (not on every keystroke)
Scroll to bottom of reports list and confirm Next Page button appears if more than 50 records exist
Click Next Page and confirm new records load
Reload page and observe skeleton components appear briefly before real data
Scroll down a long list and watch Network tab - images should load as they enter viewport, not all at once
Check browser console for any React warnings about missing dependencies
